svg.title: superdev - flow: the Simple track and the Super track
svg.desc: Flow diagram of the superdev plugin: entry (an idea or a bug), the interview in the superdev skill, the track-selection gate, the Simple track (simpleplan, simpleplan-reviewer, hook, simplebuild) and the Super track (superspec, superplan, superbuild with a review after every task), and a shared Close Out with optional adr, memory, rules and docs delegations.
svg.text: From an idea to committed code. The same interview at the entrance, two delivery tracks.
fork - separate context, returns a verdict
hook - hard block in the harness
gate - waits for a human decision
Trace the flow step by step - no guessing.
The reproducing test must be RED - that is the proof.
Does not fix here: it hands over a proven fix plan.
New idea · feature · change to something existing
Explore (agents in parallel) - maps code, patterns, rules.
Interview: one question per turn, in prose, numbered options.
No code and no plan until there is shared understanding.
GATE - the user picks the track
AskUserQuestion · never skip this choice on your own
SUPER TRACK - large, hard to undo
EnterPlanMode · plan = How · no spec, the plan carries the DoD.
Self-Review with fresh eyes, only then the reviewer.
plan → the path out of plan mode
needs-discovery → back to superdev, not an endless loop
PreToolUse → blocks ExitPlanMode until there is a PASS
GATE - a human approves the plan
Implement → own Review → Build + Test (up to 5 rounds).
FAIL → asks the user: retry / skip / abort.
commits the task + its number in status.md
Final review. FAIL → the implementor fixes (max. 2 rounds).
review reports land in the commit
• no spec - the plan carries its own acceptance criteria
• a single reviewer at the end
• spec What & Why + its own reviewer, then the plan
• the plan forces TDD: required on tasks
• plan-header carries out-of-scope and spec constraints
• coder: opus + a reviewer after every task (up to 3 rounds)
• two reviewers at the end: spec, then code
Shared: the same hook before ExitPlanMode · a commit per task · Close Out
Spec = What & Why · never How · INVEST · max. 3 AC per story.
No TBDs and no open questions - the spec holds the answers.
VERDICT: PASS / FAIL - no PASS, no handover.
GATE - plan, or stop at the spec?
Plan = How from the spec. What & Why are closed - never reopened.
Every task gets a TDD: required marker (or TDD: none).
plan → the path out of plan mode
Checks the plan against the spec → VERDICT: PASS / FAIL.
The same hook - one shared entrance to code, for both tracks
GATE - a human approves the plan
workdir + spec: · no spec: line → that is a job for simplebuild
TDD: required → red-green-refactor: test first, see it RED.
FAIL → the coder fixes · after 3 rounds it asks the user.
commits the task + its number in status.md
superbuild-reviewer-spec, then on its PASS superbuild-reviewer-code.
FAIL → task-coder fixes, the review starts over (max. 2 rounds)
the enabled ones run in parallel · a failed delegation does not block
A 3–5 sentence summary · ADR: / NODE: / RULE: / DOC: lines verbatim.
